purpose: Frozen round-24 C1 counter-B matrix: 4 liveness-positive cases that the round-23 brace/glob dispatch cannot resolve (empty brace alternative; glob crediting a dangling first match) and 4 controls that pin the classes a fix must preserve. Every case runs the copied resolve.py CLI once against a disposable HOME/KASEGI_MIRROR/lane tree and asserts BOTH the class and the resolved_path (existence, containment in the class's root, and the exact expected file when named). `@ROOT@` in a symlink target is the case root.

files.lane/dir/file.md: # live literal behind the empty alternative

cases.why: An empty first alternative means the brace group contributes nothing, so `dir/{,sub}/file.md` denotes `dir/file.md`. Round-23 brace_expand drops the empty branch and never builds that path, so the CLI answers GONE for a citation whose file is on disk. The extra cite pins the real-world prefix/extension shape so a fix cannot resolve L1 by breaking `prefix/{,name}.ext`.

files.lane/dir/file2.md: # the real second path `dir/sub/file2.md` is absent by design

cases.why: Same defect with the empty alternative written second: sorted expansion still discards it, so only `dir/sub/file2.md` is tested and the citation is GONE. The fixture keeps `dir/sub/` absent so the class can only be earned by the empty branch.

glob.glob() reports broken symlinks, and round-23 exists_any returns matches[0] without an existence test. The dangling `a-dangling.md` sorts before the live `b-live.md`, so the CLI credits a path that does not exist. Expectation is the first EXISTS match, `b-live.md`.

Primary: the round-23 brace branch already tests os.path.exists per expansion, so it must keep skipping the dangling first alternative and land on the live second — a fix that returns the first expansion regardless of existence is caught here (measured: the naive-brace probe fails this case with path-missing-on-disk). Second citation: the same empty-alternative defect on the bounty/mirror-fallback branch, where the only live expansion is the mirror-side empty alternative (`relocated/tbh/rank.mjs`); the frozen baseline answers GONE for it, which is what makes the case fail-before and reproduces the claim's 4/8 without dropping the primary shape. Both must pass after the fix.
Plain literal hit with no brace or glob: keeps its existing class. A resolver that answers GONE for everything cannot satisfy it.
Plain absent literal: must stay GONE with an empty resolved_path. A resolver that answers RESOLVES (or names any path) for everything cannot satisfy it.

Two live glob matches: the first sorted match (`a.md`) must win deterministically both before and after the fix. A resolver that returns any existing match other than the sorted first cannot satisfy it.

The real SKILL.md brace idiom under the bounty root, with the bounty literal absent and the mirror root present: brace expansion must still credit the mirror form. The extra cite is the verbatim four-alternative set from SKILL.md:1000, so the fix is pinned against the line that motivated it, not only against a two-way toy.
